description: This file defines the SSH class for managing SSH connections and file transfer operations within Drupal, including methods for connecting, copying files/directories, removing files/directories, checking if a path is a file or directory, changing permissions, and generating settings forms. It is deprecated in Drupal 11.2.0 and removed in Drupal 12.0.0.

classes.name: SSH
classes.description: A class for managing SSH connections and file transfers, extending FileTransfer and implementing ChmodInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SSH object with connection parameters and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an SSH connection and authenticates with username and password.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates an SSH instance based on provided settings.

methods.name: copyFileJailed
methods.description: Copies a file to the remote server via SCP.

methods.name: copyDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Copies a directory on the remote server.

methods.name: createDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Creates a directory on the remote server.

methods.name: removeDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Removes a directory on the remote server.

methods.name: removeFileJailed
methods.description: Removes a file on the remote server.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory (untested).

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a path is a file.

methods.name: chmodJailed
methods.description: Changes permissions of a file or directory.

methods.name: getSettingsForm
methods.description: Returns the settings form with default port value.
